questions.question: Solve 25 plus 15 equals box plus 30 and explain what the equals sign tells you.
questions.expected_answer: The equals sign says both sides have the same value. The left side is 40, so box plus 30 must also be 40, which makes the box 10. Check: 10 plus 30 is 40.

questions.question: Use trial and improvement to solve 23 times box equals 552. Show your tries.
questions.expected_answer: Try 20: 23 times 20 is 460, too small. Try 25: 23 times 25 is 575, too big. Try 24: 23 times 24 is 552, which is correct. The box is 24.

questions.question: Solve box minus 368 equals 1 250 and check your answer by substitution.
questions.expected_answer: Undo subtracting 368 by adding 368: 1 250 plus 368 is 1 618. Substitute: 1 618 minus 368 is 1 250, which is true, so the box is 1 618.
